about:
Vapor Apparel is based in Hanahan, South Carolina, and was founded in 2008. The company operates as a manufacturer of sun-protective performance apparel.

The company produces a range of UPF 50+ rated shirts, hoodies, base layers, and midweight polos for men and women. Its product lines include the Solar series, midweight fabrics designed for layering, and a print shop offering custom graphics on stock garments. Vapor Apparel also runs a wholesale division supplying retailers and bulk buyers.

The brand targets outdoor enthusiasts in fishing, hunting, coastal, and general sun-protection markets. Its wholesale channel serves retailers and promotional-product distributors, while the print shop caters to organizations seeking custom-branded sun-protective wear.

Vapor Apparel emphasizes its proprietary SolarBloc® technology, which provides permanent UPF 50+ protection combined with moisture-wicking and stretch properties. The company also highlights a partnership with the Skin Cancer Foundation, underscoring its focus on sun safety.
